title: Pan Color and Reflectivity: How Light vs Dark Surfaces Change Searing, Browning, and Baking Outcomes
summary: In this short segment from America's Test Kitchen’s Techniquely, Lan Lam explains how the color and shine of cookware influence cooking results. The host argues that light-colored skillets improve visibility of fond formation for pan sauces and help monitor butter browning, while dark pans alter browning and flavor development. The discussion extends to baking, noting that dark cake pans and muffin tins absorb heat and can affect sides and bottoms, with aluminum sheet pans’ reflectivity also changing browning behavior. The video closes with practical notes on shiny versus matte pans and how appearance can guide cooking times, plus references to Gear Heads and Cook’s Illustrated for further information.

sections.title: Light-colored pans improve fond visibility and browning control
sections.description: Introduces the idea that a light-colored skillet lets you see fond development and browning more clearly, helping prevent underdeveloped flavor or burnt notes.

sections.title: Baking with dark pans: heat absorption and browning considerations
concepts: texture and doneness in baked goods
sections.description: States that dark cake pans and muffin tins absorb heat more readily, affecting the color and texture of baked edges and bottoms, especially for longer bakes.

sections.title: Aluminum sheet pan reflectivity and browning speed
sections.description: Explains that aluminum sheet pans lose their shine over time, becoming more heat-absorbent and encouraging faster browning.

sections.title: Garlic bread browning: color and crispness
sections.description: Shows two garlic breads baked for 18 minutes with a noticeable difference in color and crispness, illustrating color as a cue for doneness.

sections.title: Shiny vs matte sheet pans and cook time
sections.description: Notes that shiny pans can require longer cooking times, while matte/darker pans tend to brown faster, affecting efficiency.

sections.title: Using pan appearance to guide timing
sections.description: Emphasizes using visual appearance to adjust cook times when recipes don’t align with actual results.

sections.title: Resources for cookware shopping and gear reviews
sections.description: Directs viewers to Gear Heads for cookware shopping information and cooksillustrated.com for gear reviews.
